info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Rideshare Rides Status-v3-spec
info.description: The Rideshare Rides Status API provides a comprehensive overview of the status of various rideshare rides. It offers developers the ability to query the current state of rides, ensuring they have access to up-to-date information on ride availability and progress. This API is essential for applications that require real-time updates on rideshare operations, catering to taxi services, transportation apps, and logistics companies. By integrating this API, businesses can enhance user experience and improve ride management capabilities.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the current status of their rides, including information about ongoing, completed, or canceled rides. It provides essential details that help users understand the state of their transportation requests.

requestBody.description: A request to retrieve the current status of a ride. This payload includes any necessary parameters to specify the desired ride status.

ListRideshareRidesStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the request body in JSON format for the GET operation related to ride status.
